note: Leads are MOF-related sources found through search-result listings only. They are NOT verified and NOT part of data/mof-catalog.json: licence, data terms, repository contents and maintenance have not been checked. Each moves into the catalog only after its primary source is opened and checked.

leads.title: Exploring the Chemical Design Space of Metal-Organic Frameworks for Photocatalysis
leads.whyUnverified: A search summary tied the paper to the pred_cdp repository and the Zenodo record. On 2026-10-14 the repository's raw README and LICENSE files returned HTTP 404 on main and master, and the Zenodo record could not be opened from the verifier's network.
leads.whatToCheck: Whether the repository exists and is public, its licence, and the Zenodo record's files and licence.

leads.title: uMOF: A Universal Database, Benchmark, and Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials for Metal-Organic Frameworks
leads.whyUnverified: Known only from a search-result title. The preprint text, data location, code and licences were not read.
leads.whatToCheck: Where the database and potentials are released, under which licences, and whether the preprint has since been peer-reviewed.

leads.title: Linker Functionalization and pH Tuning Enhance Solar-Driven Catalytic CO2 Reduction in MOF-5
leads.whyUnverified: Known only from a search-result title. It is a study, and whether it releases code or data was not checked.
leads.whatToCheck: Whether any code or data are released; if not, it belongs in a reading list rather than the tool catalog.

leads.title: MACE-MP-MOF0: a MOF-specific fine-tune of MACE-MP-0 for phonons
leads.whyUnverified: Search results describe a fine-tune of MACE-MP-0b on 127 curated MOFs that corrects imaginary phonon modes. No repository, Zenodo record or weights location was found, and the paper itself was not read.
leads.whatToCheck: The code/data availability statement for where the weights are hosted, and under which licence.

leads.title: Comparing Classical and Machine Learning Force Fields for Modeling Deformation of Metal-Organic Frameworks Relevant for Direct Air Capture
leads.whyUnverified: Known from search-result summaries: it compares CHGNet, MACE-MP-0 and Equiformer V2 with a classical force field on adsorbate-induced MOF deformation. The paper text and any released code or data were not read.
leads.whatToCheck: Whether code or data are released, and the paper's own numbers before quoting any.

checkedNotAdded.reason: Named in the Talk1 slide extract and checked against the repository's own files on 2026-10-14. MatterGen, MACE, CHGNet and MatGL were added to the catalog with 'not MOF-specific' caveats. The item below was not, because only the fairchem README (not the OMat24 dataset page and licence) was read.

items.name: OMat24 (facebookresearch/fairchem)
items.note: Inorganic bulk materials dataset used to train fairchem models; the OMat24 dataset page and licence were not opened. fairchem's README does mention MOFs, which is why ODAC25 and OC20 are in the catalog.

checkedNotAdded.notChecked: GNoME, A-Lab, Materials Project (core database) and the slide deck itself were not opened. The Materials Project MOF Explorer is already in the catalog.
